svg.title: Хип-траст на полу с паузой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Paused floor hip thrust, bodyweight glute bridge. Side view, head, shoulders, and arms resting on floor in both poses, knees bent, both feet flat. START pelvis rests on floor. FINISH pause at raised pelvis position with shoulder-to-hip-to-knee line nearly straight. Shoulders and feet still anchored at their exact original locations. No bench, no weight, no arrows, no pause symbols. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
